note: The icons of WP-P0-12, keyed by config item id (src/data/gen/items.js). Sizes in millimetres; the Blender builders (render.py) and the label art (labels.mjs) both read them, so a label always fits its container. pose.yaw turns the subject about Z (degrees, counter-clockwise from above) in front of the fixed camera; pose.tilt leans it towards the camera. quality is how a dish is cooked in its render (dishes.QUALITY); serves lists the config item ids one icon stands for (a recipe's Perfect, Good and Normal tiers share one render; Failed has its own), and icons carry no tier badge.
